issue: Six bounded Pump differential runners read the captured Pump/AMM images, the captured config snapshot, the saved migration transaction and the dependency ELFs, then truncated --output with write_bytes. Passing an input as --output destroyed captured evidence, or replaced the executing runner with its own report.
affected: scripts/pump_holder_distribution_differential.py, scripts/pump_idl_authority_differential.py, scripts/pump_incentives_admin_differential.py, scripts/pump_volume_sync_differential.py, scripts/pump_migrate_differential.py, scripts/pump_migrate_v2_differential.py at base; each writer is the last statement of its main block
finding: Base run of the new test: 20 failing subtests in 5 tests. --output on the captured image overwrote it, and --output on the runner itself replaced the module with the report so the same run could no longer import it. Sibling runners (pump_minimum_fee_differential, pump_create_differential, pump_claim_panic_differential, the AMM family) already admit their destination.

change.publisher: PumpReport(output, ROOT, candidate, __file__, extra_inputs=[...]) built before any case executes
change.report_inputs: the migration pair declares research/imported-lab/analysis/pump_fun/curve-migrate-v2-signed-surfpool.json, the saved transaction its probe replays; the other four read only inputs PumpReport already protects
change.write: publisher.write(payload) with the existing payload construction (gzip.compress(...,mtime=0) where the runner gzips)
change.failure: ValueError: report output aliases an input: <path>, exit 1, before a case runs and before any output directory is created

runs.case_payload_unchanged: base and proposed receipts are identical after ignoring script_sha256: holder_distribution 649 cases, idl_authority 171, incentives_admin 299, volume_sync 341, migrate 228, migrate_v2 827, all with no mismatches
runs.alias_refusals: 20 refusals exercised by the new test (captured image, captured config snapshot, saved migration transaction for the pair, executing script); each exits non-zero with the alias message and leaves the target bytes unchanged
runs.publication_control: each runner publishes a fresh nested receipt: mismatch-free JSON, non-empty cases, and no staging file left beside it

tests.before: 20 failing subtests in 5 tests against the base scripts (218.1s)

unchanged: captured images, dependency ELFs, config snapshot and saved transaction
report schema, gzip mtime pinning and compact separators
